question: What is the one word for “A person who is talkative”?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Garrulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garrulous"** refers to someone who is excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. (बातूनी)

 
 
• **Example: **The garrulous old man spent hours telling stories about his childhood.
 
 
 
• **"Talkative" **means someone who talks a lot or enjoys talking, often to the point of being verbose. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example: **My neighbor is so talkative that our short conversations often stretch to an hour.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that best describes "a person who is talkative" is **'Garrulous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Garrulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Introvert **(अंतर्मुखी): A person who tends to be quiet, reserved, and introspective.

 
 
• **Example:** As an introvert, she often prefers reading a book over attending social gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Reticent **(मितभाषी ): Someone who is not inclined to share their thoughts or feelings readily.
 
 
• **Example: **He was reticent about his plans for the future, keeping them to himself.
 
 
 
• **Taciturn** (मौन, कम बोलने वाला): Someone who is naturally quiet and reserved, speaking very little.
 
 
• **Example:** He was taciturn during the meeting, barely contributing to the discussion.
